stores_public.def:
SELECT id,
    name,
    short_name,
    address,
    opening_date,
    status,
    capacity,
    rooms,
    color,
    is_temporary,
    temporary_date,
    temporary_dates,
    organization_id,
    display_order,
    region,
    temporary_venue_names,
    kit_group_id,
    access_info,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    ownership_type,
    public_name
   FROM stores
  WHERE ownership_type IS NULL OR ownership_type <> 'office'::text;
